## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug. What happened? What did you expect to happen?

## Reproduction Steps

Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Enter '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behaviour

What actually happened. Include error messages, stack traces, or console output if available.

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the problem.

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| OS | e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04 |
| Browser | e.g. Chrome 126, Firefox 128, Safari 17 |
| Node.js version | e.g. 20.14.0 |
| npm version | e.g. 10.7.0 |
| Branch / Commit | e.g. main / abc1234 |

## Additional Context

Any other context about the problem. Links to related issues, relevant configuration, or anything else that might help diagnose the issue.
